title: Poetics adapter request
description: What the core writes on an out-of-process adapter's stdin: one batch of files to read as one program (ADR 0025).

root.description: The repository root, absolute. The adapter runs with it as its working directory.

text.description: The file's text as it was at a commit. When absent, the adapter reads the file from disk.

path.description: Relative to the repository root, with forward slashes, never leaving it.
